text: This solution, QuakeCoRE 2025 Annual Meeting (QCAM25) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Aotearoa New Zealand between University of Canterbury, Public Research Organisations (PROs), Government Ministries and National Agencies, City and Regional Councils, Civil Defence and Emergency Management (CDEM) professionals, Global Earthquake Model (GEM) Foundation, and Industry members and consulting firms. The program was implemented in 2025 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
